body:
Coordinator lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-24, my own mistake).

The 50 GiB disk floor for a FULL gate is enforced by scripts/test-launcher.mjs itself. Its disk-space preflight refuses admission when any checked location has less than 50 GiB available: "full gate refused by disk-space preflight: need at least 50 GiB available at every checked location".

A coordinator "waiver" of that floor therefore does nothing. I waived it for the w-4483 R14 Windows B FULL, and test-b4eea8bd was refused at admission in 1.3 s with 49.4 GiB free. The cost was one wasted round trip.

When a host is under 50 GiB, there are only two options:
- free space through an authorized cleanup path;
- run the FULL on another host that qualifies, for example Central for a Windows gate, registered.
Check the launcher's own rules before ruling on a runner threshold.
